children: MISC's potential deal to take Yinson private is likely to cloud its dividend outlook, given funding and balance-sheet risks, Affin Hwang IB analyst Tze Hern Ong says in a note. MISC is in preliminary discussions with Yinson Legacy and the Employees Provident Fund over potentially taking it private at 2.35 ringgit a share. While the deal could strengthen MISC's offshore capabilities and expand its contracted earnings base, the estimated 3.8 billion ringgit consideration could constrain dividend capacity if funded with cash, he says. A share-based deal could dilute earnings and dividends per share, he reckons. MISC's exposure to Yinson's debt and future capital commitments could also weigh on its balance sheet, he adds. Affin maintains a hold rating on MISC and keeps its target price at 8.65 ringgit. Shares are 2.8% higher at 8.14 ringgit. (yingxian.wong@wsj.com)
